title: Texas Roadhouse offers free lunch to Vets

asr.full_text: Veterans could enjoy a hearty meal today at Texas Roadhouse in Terre Haute. The restaurant opened their annual free Veterans Day lunch to show their gratitude for those who have served. Before the doors opened, there was a celebration in the parking lot. There, the manager told News 10 they hope to surpass the 6,000 to 7,000 guests they served last year. She says there is no way they wouldn't continue to do this every year,. As it's the least they can do to express their thanks. We are honoring them by offering a free lunch today. We'll extend those extended hours for them as well. It's our day to serve those that have served us and to give back.
